start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:method-name-question-delete on: cut the time a new baker needs to learn the morning bake."
no_lists_because: It is a way of thinking a request through, answered in words step by step, and it reads and writes no list.
instructions: 1. Say the thing you are about to build or change in one plain sentence, for example "cut the time a new baker needs to learn the morning bake", and say "Run workflow:method-name-question-delete" with it as request.

2. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run (row workflow:method-name-question-delete) and answers its steps in order: outcome, alignment, question, baseline, root, delete, rule-out, owner, smallest-change, accelerate, automate, risk, proof; each answer is refused until every check of the step is answered about this request.
3. At delete, drop every demand or step that is not needed before improving anything; restore only what then fails.
4. Automate only at the automate step, after the change works by hand, and only through what already exists.
